def csv-options
  record
    entry :delimiter ","
    entry :newline "\r\n"
    entry :header true
    entry :null-text ""
    entry :missing :error

def csv-field [options cell]
  concat
    "\""
    replace-text "\"" "\"\""
      scalar-text options cell
    "\""

def csv-row [options cells]
  concat
    join (get :delimiter options)
      map
        fn [cell]
          csv-field options cell
        cells
    get :newline options
